options.name: debug_mode
options.description: Whether debug mode is enabled or disabled.

options.name: gui_access
options.description: Frontend authentication method of the users in the group. Possible values: default -  use the system default authentication method; internal - use internal authentication; LDAP - use LDAP authentication; disable - disable access to the frontend.

options.name: hostgroup_rights
options.description: Host group permissions to assign to the user group For => Zabbix 7.0

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the user group to create, update or delete.

options.name: rights
options.description: Permissions to assign to the group For <= Zabbix 6.0

options.name: state
options.description: State of the user group. On C(present), it will create if user group does not exist or update the user group if the associated data is different. On C(absent) will remove a user group if it exists.

options.name: status
options.description: Whether the user group is enabled or disabled.

options.name: tag_filters
options.description: Tag based permissions to assign to the group

options.name: templategroup_rights
options.description: Template group permissions to assign to the user group For => Zabbix 7.0

options.name: userdirectory
options.description: Authentication user directory when gui_access set to LDAP or System default. For => Zabbix 7.0
